summary: Every course must be taken for a letter grade and for at least four units, toward the 65 units the major needs; ARTHIST courses beyond the named requirements count toward that total. The audit checks the core courses, a 4-unit ARTSTUDI course, three survey courses, two courses in each temporal category and each geographic category, and a FILMEDIA course. A course fills one temporal and one geographic category, and survey, concentration and FILMEDIA courses may also fill categories; the audit cannot stop one course from filling two geographic categories, so check that yourself. You check by hand the three-course area of concentration, the library orientation, at most two courses (10 units) taken away from Stanford, and for honors 10 units of ARTHIST 297, the thesis and the 3.5 GPAs.
